verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is API-first. It documents a public Payments API v3, a Data API and a Verification API, with authentication and request signing, a test-payment quickstart, webhooks, official SDKs in Node.js, Python, Java and .NET, and open-source signing libraries on GitHub. That is enough for an AI-native user to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of the API in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Payments API v3 allows you to make and accept payments and payouts in the UK and EU.
Access identity, accounts, transactions and balance data for all integrated banks with a single interface.
SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET.
The Payments API v3 uses a pair of ECDSA keys in addition to a bearer token.
you'll create a free UK merchant account and complete your first test payment with the Payments API v3
